mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, owner_user_id, parent_id, object_id, sort_order, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, deleted FROM doc_library_node WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND object_id = #{objectId} ORDER BY deleted ASC, id DESC LIMIT 1
